theorems.name: MathAI.Trust.add_zero_verified
theorems.statement: For every natural number n, n + 0 = n.

theorems.name: MathAI.Trust.square_nonnegative
theorems.statement: For every real x, 0 ≤ x^2.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.origin_on_xy_plane
theorems.statement: The origin lies on the exact rational xy-plane with normal (0,0,1) and offset 0.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.unit_x_on_unit_sphere
theorems.statement: The point (1,0,0) lies on the exact rational unit sphere centered at the origin.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.dot_comm
theorems.statement: The exact rational 3D dot product is symmetric.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.dot_zero_left
theorems.statement: The dot product of the zero vector with any exact rational vector is zero.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.dot_zero_right
theorems.statement: The dot product of any exact rational vector with the zero vector is zero.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.orthogonal_symm
theorems.statement: Exact rational vector orthogonality is symmetric.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.zero_orthogonal_left
theorems.statement: The zero vector is orthogonal to every exact rational vector.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.zero_orthogonal_right
theorems.statement: Every exact rational vector is orthogonal to the zero vector.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.squaredDistance_self
theorems.statement: The squared distance from an exact rational point to itself is zero.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.squaredDistance_symm
theorems.statement: Exact rational squared distance is symmetric.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.squaredDistance_nonnegative
theorems.statement: Exact rational squared distance is nonnegative.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.validSphere_of_pointOnSphere
theorems.statement: A point-on-sphere proof entails validity of the exact rational sphere.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.squaredDistance_eq_radius_of_pointOnSphere
theorems.statement: A point-on-sphere proof entails that squared distance to the center equals the sphere radius squared.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.cross_zero_left
theorems.statement: The cross product of the zero vector with any exact rational vector is the zero vector.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.cross_zero_right
theorems.statement: The cross product of any exact rational vector with the zero vector is the zero vector.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.cross_self
theorems.statement: The cross product of an exact rational vector with itself is the zero vector.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.vecBetween_self
theorems.statement: The exact rational displacement from a point to itself is the zero vector.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.parallel_zero_left
theorems.statement: The zero vector is parallel to every exact rational vector under the kernel predicate.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.parallel_zero_right
theorems.statement: Every exact rational vector is parallel to the zero vector under the kernel predicate.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.parallel_self
theorems.statement: Every exact rational vector is parallel to itself under the kernel predicate.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.dot_self_nonnegative
theorems.statement: The exact rational dot product of a vector with itself is nonnegative.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.validPlane_of_pointOnPlane
theorems.statement: A point-on-plane proof entails validity of the exact rational plane.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.validLine_of_pointOnLine
theorems.statement: A point-on-line proof entails validity of the exact rational line.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.squaredDistance_eq_dot_vecBetween
theorems.statement: Squared distance equals the self-dot product of the displacement vector between the two exact rational points.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.cross_orthogonal_left
theorems.statement: The exact rational cross product of two vectors is orthogonal to its left input.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.cross_orthogonal_right
theorems.statement: The exact rational cross product of two vectors is orthogonal to its right input.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.squaredDistance_origin_quarterTurnZ
theorems.statement: A quarter-turn around the z-axis preserves exact rational squared distance from the origin.

theorems.name: MathAI.Geometry.pointOn_xyCircleAtOrigin_quarterTurnZ
theorems.statement: A quarter-turn around the z-axis preserves membership in an exact rational circle centered at the origin in the xy-plane.
